heading: Thursday, April 16, 2026
topLine: 3 model releases: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7, Alibaba Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and OpenAI GPT-Rosalind.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.7
items.summary: Claude Opus 4.7 improves on Opus 4.6 in advanced software engineering, adds higher-resolution vision and a new xhigh effort level, and ships with automatic cyber-misuse safeguards. Pricing is unchanged at $5/$25 per million tokens.

image.alt: Header image from the Claude Opus 4.7 announcement

items.headline: Alibaba releases open-weight Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
items.summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is an Apache-2.0 open-weight multimodal MoE model (35B total, 3B active) aimed at agentic coding, with 262K native context. Qwen reports 73.4 on SWE-bench Verified and claims it beats Gemma 4 models on its published benchmarks.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces GPT-Rosalind for life sciences
items.summary: GPT-Rosalind is a reasoning model specialized for biology, drug discovery and translational medicine, tuned for multi-step use of scientific tools and databases. It launched as a limited-access research preview for qualified organizations in ChatGPT, Codex and the API, with partners including Amgen and Moderna.
